audience: Peruvian businesses that issue facturas, boletas and notes to SUNAT with NubeFact

useCases.title: Issue a factura, boleta or note to SUNAT
useCases.text: Check the series and number first, with a document read. Then issue the factura, boleta or note, which NubeFact sends to SUNAT.

useCases.title: Check whether SUNAT accepted a document
useCases.text: Read one issued document to see whether SUNAT accepted it. The same read gives its PDF, XML and CDR links.

useCases.title: Void a wrong document and check the voiding
useCases.text: Void an issued document that is wrong. The voiding is final, so check it later with a voiding status read.

useCases.title: Check the voiding status of a document
useCases.text: Read the voiding of a factura, boleta or note. See the SUNAT ticket and whether SUNAT accepted it.
